ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_gatenk: Visit the &6Holey Cheese Hills&r on the outer islands of the Guh End. Rolling yellow hills full of round holes, with a little pond of cheese sauce here and there. Who has been nibbling here?
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_korstw: Visit the &6Rind Desert&r on the outer islands of the Guh End. Flat, dry and cracked, with dunes of crumb sand that you sink into. Somewhere there is an oasis, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_kruime: Visit the &6Crumb Clouds&r on the outer islands of the Guh End. Crumbs that float and clouds you slowly sink through. Watch where you land! This region is small and rare: have a good look around.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_schimm: Visit the &6Blue Cheese Plains&r on the outer islands of the Guh End. Blue cheese as far as you can see, mist, ponds and giant mushrooms that glow. It smells... special here. This region is small and rare: have a good look around.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_krista: Visit the &6Crystal Cheese Cliffs&r on the outer islands of the Guh End. Tall pillars of old cliff cheese with golden crystals on them. This is where the &6crystal cheese&r grows. This region is small and rare: have a good look around.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_knabbe: Visit the &6Nibble Chorus Forest&r on the outer islands of the Guh End. Tall purple nibble chorus plants that softly sing. Be quiet and listen: every flower has its own note. This region is small and rare: have a good look around.
advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_biomes: Visit all six regions of the outer islands
Mine crystal cheese in the Crystal Cheese Cliffs
Eat a nibble chorus fruit and suddenly stand somewhere else
item.guhs.knabbelkoorvrucht.lore: Chomp... floop! Suddenly you stand a little further on, nyeg
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_krista: In the Crystal Cheese Cliffs there is &6crystal cheese ore&r in the cliff cheese, and golden crystals grow on the pillars. Mine some &6crystal cheese&r. Nine nuggets make a whole one too. (Not for eating: it is far too hard for that.)
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_vrucht: Chop down a nibble chorus plant and eat a &dnibble chorus fruit&r. Floop: suddenly you stand a little further on. Handy near a cliff. Or not at all, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_gepoft: Put a nibble chorus fruit in the furnace: it pops open. Four &dpopped nibble chorus fruits&r make four nibble chorus blocks, and those make stairs, slabs and pillars.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_biomes_lichts: A Little Light for Your Guh
A popped nibble chorus fruit on a guh crystal: four &dlight rods&r. Now the Guh End is never completely dark again.
